21. Which team will play the most games at the stadium this month? A. Washington Commanders. B. Los Angeles Rams. C. Los Angeles Chargers. D. New Orleans Saints. 答案：B 原文明确说公羊队每赛季在此主场作战场次最多。
22. Which hotel is the nearest to the stadium? A. Sonder Lum Hotel. B. The Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles. C. The H Hotel Los Angeles. D. The Renaissance LA Airport Hotel 答案：A 原文称Sonder Lum Hotel就在体育场街对面，位置最佳。
23. What do you need to do if you want to park at the stadium? A. Call the parking staff. B. Prepay the parking fee. C. Obtain a parking pass. D. Choose a parking zone. 答案：C 原文建议通过ParkWhiz提前购买停车通行证。
24. What does Kevin usually do to get the meaning of a word? A. Use electronic devices. B. Consult a paper dictionary. C. Guess from the context. D. Turn to his English teacher. 答案：A Kevin认为词典每章一个字母，说明他平时用电子设备查词。
25. How did Kevin feel while looking up the word in the dictionary? A. Annoyed. B. Disappointed. C. Encouraged. D. Astonished. 答案：D Kevin对一页竟有那么多同前缀单词感到又惊又叹。
26. What can we learn about the author's first dictionary? A. It helped her through the college. B. It was given to Kevin as a gift. C. It bore witness to her efforts. D. It was a valuable limited edition. 答案：C 作者在词典上逐条做标记，词典见证了她的努力。
27. What has the author come to realize about learning? A. It is never too late to start. B. Motivation is what really matters. C. Children need role models. D. Dictionaries are still a useful tool. 答案：B 作者强调自己查词是出于兴趣和体验，动力最重要。
28. What does the new study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They affect the growth of other trees. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They harm people's health indirectly. D. They raise the local temperature slowly. 答案：C 橡树和枫香树释放的异戊二烯会间接形成臭氧危害健康。
29. Which of the following may Commane suggest based on their study? A. Cutting down the isoprene-producing trees. B. Suspending tree-planting for a few decades. C. Changing the species of trees in new plantings. D. Removing isoprene released by existing trees. 答案：C Commane提醒种树需谨慎，暗示应改变新植树种。
30. What does the underlined phrase "oblivious to" in paragraph 5 mean? A. Honest about. B. Unaware of. C. Related to. D. Optimistic about. 答案：B oblivious to意为“未意识到”，许多市民不知此关联。
31. What would Auyeung probably advocate? A. Reducing car use in daily life. B. Providing animals with new habitats. C. Controlling population growth. D. Doing more research on the problem. 答案：A Auyeung认为问题在汽车排放，应减少日常用车。
32. What was the task of the "beauty" group? A. Matching line drawings with objects. B. Rating how beautiful each object was. C. Creating their own clay objects. D. Describing their daily worries. 答案：B “美”组任务是给每件作品的美感打分。
33. According to the study, which group was more likely to think beyond daily life? A. The beauty group, who showed greater interest in bigger questions. B. The beauty group, who felt much happier afterwards. C. The control group, who showed stronger abstract thinking. D. The control group, who felt more enlightened. 答案：A 美组在抽象思维上得分更高，更关注人生大问题。
34. Why did the researchers ask about the participants' feelings? A. They attract the southern pine beetle. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They suffer because of human activities. D. They pose the largest threat to cities. 答案：C 研究关注艺术之美如何影响人的思维与感受。
35. What can be inferred about the future of the trees in the city? A. Existing trees are likely to be replaced. B. Some tree species require urgent protection. C. The city's tree population will decline. D. The city's tree diversity will be maintained. 答案：D 研究者主张重新规划树种，城市树木多样性将得以保持。
36. 36___________. 答案：E 该句引出博物馆作为学习场所，衔接下文AI应用。
37. 37__________. 答案：D 该句说明AI能按年龄和学习风格定制推荐。
38. 38___________ Moreover, it can predict how a fragile painting may age over the years, allowing experts to step in before any visible damage appears. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：A 该句总结AI在艺术品修复方面的能力，与后文预测老化衔接。
39. 39___________ For instance, a curious child and a trained art expert standing before the same painting might each receive a completely different guided tour. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：G 该句引出AI设计更具吸引力的展览，与后文举例衔接。
40. 40___________ Strict rules are therefore needed to ensure that every visitor's privacy is fully protected. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：B 该句谈访客数据隐私风险，与后文需要严格规则衔接。
41. The 41______ that people only really knew Ohio for the three C's - Cleveland, Cincinnati, or Columbus (not Cortland!) - came quickly when I decided to go to school in central Pennsylvania. A. fantasy B. prejudice C. realization D. expectation 答案：C 作者去宾州上学后才“意识到”人们对俄亥俄的刻板印象。
42. Half of my peers didn't even realize I lived a 42____ three and a half hours away. A. only B. indeed C. still D. even 答案：A 强调家乡“仅仅”三个半小时车程，用only。
43. The 43____ are never-ending. A. tests B. questions C. games D. debates 答案：B 下文列举各种提问，说明问题没完没了。
44. I was a unicorn in their eyes, a 44____ Or, on second thought, maybe just a country hick. A. success B. victim C. novelty D. problem 答案：C 作者在同学眼中像独角兽，是稀罕的新奇事物。
45. As I grow older, I'm more and more 45____ for my small town roots. A. thankful B. hopeful C. suitable D. reliable 答案：A 随着年龄增长，作者对小镇出身更加感激。
46. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46____ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47____, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48____ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. dream B. lie C. bear D. complain 答案：D 朋友们爱抱怨在偏远小镇很无聊。
47. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46____ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47____, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48____ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. therefore B. however C. instead D. otherwise 答案：B 前后为转折关系，用however。
48. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46____ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47____, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48____ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. touring B. challenging C. leaving D. protecting 答案：C 只有“离开”小镇后才意识到自己多爱它。
49. For one, the pace of life isn't anxiety provoking and people really 49 ______ connecting to each other. A. value B. admit C. fear D. remember 答案：A 小镇生活节奏舒缓，人们真正“重视”彼此联系。
50. That means that you do more than just talk to your next door neighbors - in a lot of cases, they're truly an 50 ______ of your family. A. advantage B. example C. owner D. extension 答案：D 邻居往往是家庭的“延伸”，用extension。
51. So much of this 51 ______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52 ______ is a critical part of the culture. A. lifestyle B. landscape C. procedure D. personality 答案：A 这种“生活方式”围绕户外活动和熟悉小镇展开。
52. So much of this 51 ______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52 ______ is a critical part of the culture. A. findings B. surroundings C. belongings D. greetings 答案：B 留意自己的“周围环境”是当地文化的重要部分。
53. As I move through my college years, I 53 ______ the visits to my little hometown. A. give up B. put off C. face up to D. look forward to 答案：D 作者“期待”回小镇的探访。
54. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：C 感激成长所处的环境，用surroundings。
55. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：D 小镇根脉能“指引”作者走向正确方向。
56. It is also common for them 56 ______ (hold) on traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival, also known as the Chinese New Year, and Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as other local festivals. 答案：to hold it is common for sb. to do sth.结构，用不定式。
57. The exact dates and 57 ______ (frequent) of dajis vary from region to region. 答案：frequency 与dates并列作主语，需名词形式。
58. Dajis evolved from the folk custom of trading goods, which can be traced back to 58 ______ Han Dynasty (202 B.C.-A.D. 答案：the 朝代前用定冠词the Han Dynasty。
59. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ______ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ______ (necessity). 答案：were 主语为复数且叙述过去，用were。
60. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ______ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ______ (necessity). 答案：necessities daily necessities为固定搭配，用复数。
61. They would trade their surplus items 61 ______ the goods they needed. 答案：for trade A for B表示用A换B。
62. 62 ______ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63 ______ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：Drawn 过去分词作状语，表示被香味吸引。
63. 62 ______ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63 ______ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：eating 现在分词作伴随状语，表示吃着蒸饺。
64. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：heading 介词before后接动名词。
65. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：cheaper 有much修饰且表比较，用比较级。
—— 共 45 题 ——
